info.name: Ghar Ka Sathi — Backend API
info.description:
Full API collection for the Ghar Ka Sathi backend, organized into the 3 product panels: Service Provider Panel, User Panel, Admin Panel.

HOW TO USE:
1. Import this file AND 'postman_environment.json' into Postman, then select the 'Ghar Ka Sathi - Local' environment (top-right dropdown).
2. Make sure the backend is running (npm run dev) and MONGO_URI points to a live MongoDB.

SUGGESTED RUN ORDER (a booking involves BOTH a provider and a user, so the two panels genuinely interleave — this is the realistic order, not strictly top-to-bottom by folder):
  1. Service Provider Panel > Registration/Login, then > Setup (Admin Bootstrap) — creates the shared category and admin login used everywhere else.
  2. Service Provider Panel > Profile Management, then > Admin Approval — provider must be approved before anyone can book them.
  3. User Panel > Registration/Login, then > Search Services, then > Book Service & Track Booking (creates the booking).
  4. Service Provider Panel > Order/Booking Receive — accept the quote, mark in-progress, mark completed.
  5. User Panel > Rate & Review, > Online Payment (or Service Provider Panel > Earnings Dashboard for cash payment), > Chat, > Complaints.
  6. Admin Panel — can run any time after step 1 for its setup pieces; Resolve Complaint / Payment Reports / Analytics make most sense after step 5.
3. 'Registration/Login > Check Mobile' is called BEFORE the OTP is even sent — before OTP is even sent — just tells the client if the number is new, never creates anything. 'Verify OTP' runs after the client verifies the OTP with Firebase — it always runs, for both new and existing users, and is what actually logs the user in.
4. 'Verify OTP' needs a REAL Firebase phone-auth idToken, which you will not have out of the box. Easiest options:
   a) In Firebase Console > Authentication > Sign-in method > Phone > add a test phone number, sign in with it from a client app, and paste the resulting idToken here.
   b) Ask your backend dev to seed a test User/ServiceProvider directly in MongoDB and hand you a JWT for {{userToken}} / {{providerToken}} — this is what was used during development testing.
5. IDs and tokens (categoryId, providerId, bookingId, userId, complaintId, adminToken, userToken, providerToken) auto-save into environment/collection variables via each request's Tests script, so later requests fill in automatically as long as you run things in the order above.
6. Admin-only routes need {{adminToken}}; user-only need {{userToken}}; provider-only need {{providerToken}}.

request.description: Simple liveness check — should return {"status":"ok"}.

item.name: Service Provider Panel

request.description: Call this the moment the provider taps "Send OTP", BEFORE the OTP is actually sent. Only checks whether this phone is already a registered provider — never creates anything. Returns { "newUser": true|false } for the app to decide navigation after OTP verify.

Client verifies the phone OTP with Firebase, then sends the resulting idToken here. Backend verifies it, finds-or-creates the ServiceProvider, returns our JWT. Runs for both new and existing providers. Needs a REAL Firebase idToken (see collection description).

exec: let __gksData = {};
try { __gksData = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { __gksData = {}; }
function __gksSafeGet(obj, path) { return path.split(".").reduce((o, k) => (o && o[k] !== undefined) ? o[k] : undefined, obj); }

{ const __gksV = __gksSafeGet(__gksData, 'token'); if (__gksV !== undefined) { pm.environment.set('providerToken', __gksV); pm.collectionVariables.set('providerToken', __gksV); console.log('Saved providerToken =', __gksV); } }

{ const __gksV = __gksSafeGet(__gksData, 'account._id'); if (__gksV !== undefined) { pm.environment.set('providerId', __gksV); pm.collectionVariables.set('providerId', __gksV); console.log('Saved providerId =', __gksV); } }

item.name: Order / Booking Receive

request.description: Run this after a booking exists (User Panel > Book Service & Track Booking > Create Booking). Do NOT run Reject below first, or this booking will already be in a terminal state.
Fails 400 if no price was quoted yet (accept with a price first). Needed before Earnings/Payment and User Panel > Rate & Review will work.
ALTERNATE ENDING to accepting — only valid while the booking is still pending. Test on a fresh booking, not one already accepted/completed.

item.description: {{bookingId}} comes from User Panel > Book Service & Track Booking > Create Booking — that must run before these will find anything.

request.description: Booking must be status "completed" first. Splits price into platform commission (per category) + provider payout, credits provider earnings.
Also broadcasts in real time over Socket.io to room booking:<id> — REST is enough for functional testing.

item.description: Registration, profile, category selection, location, receiving/managing bookings, earnings, and chat with the customer — everything the Plumber/Electrician/Carpenter/... registration panel needs.
